                    Public Utility Commission of Texas

                                     Memorandum


 TO:            Chairman Thomas J. Gleeson
                Commissioner Kathleen Jackson
                Commissioner Courtney K. Hjaltman
                Commissioner Morgan Johnson

 FROM:          Jessie Horn, Sr. Counsel, Rules and Projects Division

 DATE:          January 30, 2026

 RE:            February 6, 2026 Open Meeting, Agenda Item No. 46
                Project No. 58317, SB 6 Implementation


Senate Bill (SB) 6, as enacted by the Texas 89th Legislature, Regular Session, was signed by the
governor on June 1, 2025, and took effect immediately. Since the effective date of SB 6,
commission staff have worked diligently towards implementing the bill’s various provisions.

On August 1, 2025, commission staff filed a roadmap in the above-described project detailing
commission staff’s estimated timeline for implementing SB 6. That roadmap included estimated
dates for gathering information (i.e., the scoping or evaluation period), commission consideration
for proposal for publication, and commission consideration of a recommended adoption order.
The estimated dates for the scoping and evaluation periods began with the effective date of SB 6
and reflect the time frame that commission staff is gathering information, including through
informal processes, such as requests for information, questions for public comment, discussion
drafts, and workshops. This information gathering during the scoping and evaluation periods
informs commission staff’s recommended proposal for publication. The estimated dates that were
identified for the commission’s consideration of commission staff’s recommended adoption order
are approximately six months after the estimated date for the associated proposal for publication
to reflect the latest date to complete a project. The six-month time horizon was chosen based on
the requirement in Section 2001.027 of the Texas Government Code that a rule be adopted six
months after the proposal for publication or the rule is considered withdrawn.

Attached to this memorandum is an update to the roadmap, detailing the progress made in
implementing SB 6 and revised timelines for implementing the remainder of SB 6. The update to
the roadmap reflects the estimated timelines for each project, as reflected in commission staff’s
August 1, 2025 memorandum and roadmap, as well as revised estimated timelines. Below each
identified project, is a bulleted list of milestones achieved and milestones remaining. Additionally,
key members of commission staff lending their expertise across the projects implementing SB 6
are recognized for their contributions to this monumental task.

This memorandum and the attached roadmap will be placed on the agenda for the February 6, 2026
open meeting for the commission’s review.
